scope: Qualitative inspection of all 12 original Bevy captures against 12 native Open Rails 1.6.1 references. No global pixel score, no material/geometry identity certification from screenshots alone.

method.displayed_as: Six labelled 2x2 sheets at source resolution; Denham Golf Course cab originals also viewed separately.

intentional_presentation_differences: Bevy continuous solar lighting in ordinary play
Bevy tone mapping and soft shadows
The reference sun is frozen only for this comparison
limits: 450 m view radius: this set does not certify distant skyline, long viewing distances, tile streaming, all LOD transitions or a complete driven service.
Paused summer/clear daylight captures only; snow, rain, night, reflections and motion are outside this review.

Bevy tone mapping, continuous solar lighting in ordinary play and soft shadows are intentional. The native sun was frozen for this comparison; identical sun direction does not make the two shading models photometrically identical.
The HUD and station labels occlude parts of the Bevy captures; hidden pixels are not accepted as inspected scenery.
Dynamic traffic, road vehicles, semaphore aspects and gauge needles differ and are not static scenery identity evidence.
No global visual pass is inferred from the passing camera/readiness comparison.

confirmed_differences_requiring_explicit.observation: Extra Pullman in Bevy blocks part of the exterior scene; native has no train there.
confirmed_differences_requiring_explicit.impact: Cannot certify trees/platforms behind that train from this pair.

confirmed_differences_requiring_explicit.observation: The left tree row is tall and continuous in native, but rounded and separated with larger clearings in Bevy.
confirmed_differences_requiring_explicit.impact: A remaining qualitative foliage difference; source/LOD attribution has not been established in this read-only screenshot review.

observations.buildings: Station platform buildings, footbridge, rows of houses and shop facades correspond in footprint and recognizable textures. White shop fronts occur in both renderers.
observations.vegetation: Nearby trees and hedges retain cutout silhouettes; no opaque rectangular foliage quads seen. Stronger and softer Bevy shadows change the contrast.
observations.transparency: Platform fencing and vegetation cutouts remain open; train windows retain their recognizable texture/detail.
differences: Bevy terrain, rails and roofs are darker under its tone mapping and shadows.
The outer terrain/culling boundary differs; distant black areas of the reference are not an asset identity check.

observations.buildings: Cab desk, window pillars, telephone, instrument panel and visible roadside buildings correspond.
observations.vegetation: Trees along both sides are visible, with different shading/brightness.
observations.transparency: The windscreen is clear; exterior track and buildings remain visible without an opaque window surface.
differences: Blue clear sky and distant terrain shading differ from the native muted sky.
HUD and station marker are intentional overlays absent in the native capture.

observations.buildings: Both platforms, shelters, station structure, warehouse and large square office block are present in corresponding positions.
observations.vegetation: Hedgerows delineate the same nearby parcels; no opaque alpha rectangles seen.
observations.transparency: Platform railings and fence gaps are visible; no solid alpha plane obscures the station.
differences: Track ballast and platforms are darker in Bevy; foliage contrast and shadow filtering differ.

observations.buildings: Two industrial chimneys and their factory complex correspond beyond the right tracks; cab geometry remains recognizable.
observations.vegetation: Hedges and nearby trees remain visible with brighter leaf highlights in Bevy.
observations.transparency: Clear windscreen and thin wire fence are visible.
differences: The visible semaphore arm orientation differs between these runtime captures; aspect/logic parity is not certified by this scene comparison.
Background terrain and sky differ; assets beyond the 450 m view radius are outside this review.

observations.buildings: The road overbridge, stairs, platform canopies, industrial sheds and station buildings correspond. Roof and wall textures remain recognizable.
observations.vegetation: The right-side line of trees and nearby hedge are present; cutout edges are not filled by rectangular backgrounds.
observations.transparency: Bridge/stair openings and railing gaps remain visible.
differences: Additional road vehicles and their positions differ between simulations.
Soft shadows/tone mapping darken the bridge and station versus the native image.

observations.buildings: The bridge pier, opening and overhead structure correspond; the cab mesh and instruments remain in place.
observations.vegetation: The trees behind the right tracks are partly occluded by a train that is only present in the Bevy image.
observations.transparency: Clear windscreen; train windows show their authored detail.
differences: A second Pullman occupies the right half of the exterior scene in Bevy and is absent from the native reference; those occluded pixels cannot validate platform/tree equivalence.
The camera position tolerance does not imply identical parallax against the nearby bridge pillar.

observations.buildings: Platforms, nearby houses, terraces, roads and hedges retain corresponding layout. No blank white fallback building is apparent.
observations.vegetation: Trees along the road and station remain present with stronger Bevy shading.
observations.transparency: Fence gaps and individual tree silhouettes remain visible.
differences: Some house facades have substantially different brightness/color under the renderers; this review does not certify material photometry.
Terrain and distant edge appearance differ at the view boundary.

observations.buildings: Signal box and nearby built structures remain visible in corresponding directions; cab geometry and instruments correspond.
observations.vegetation: The dense right-side tree line is present with different shading and silhouette detail.
observations.transparency: Windscreen stays clear and individual telegraph wires are visible.
differences: Semaphore arm orientations differ between the runtime captures; signal state is not a scenery/material acceptance result.
Bevy rails/ground are more contrasted and the clear sky is blue rather than muted.

observations.buildings: House rows and curved road retain their layout and roof/wall texture identities.
observations.vegetation: Forests and nearby trees remain recognizable; their silhouettes and shading are not identical.
observations.transparency: Foliage outlines have visible cutouts, without solid rectangular sprite backgrounds.
differences: Forest shading and apparent tree spacing differ. This image alone cannot separate authored forest sampling from LOD/culling.

observations.buildings: White fence, houses behind the left trees and telegraph poles remain visible; cab mesh and control desk correspond.
observations.vegetation: The right forest corresponds, but the left row differs visibly: native shows taller continuous foliage; Bevy shows rounded separated crowns with houses visible through larger clearings.
observations.transparency: White fence gaps and right forest cutouts remain visible; clear windscreen.
differences: Left tree-row silhouette/coverage is an unresolved visual difference, not silently accepted as lighting or LOD.
One paused view cannot demonstrate foliage transition stability while travelling.

observations.buildings: Platform buildings, footbridge, trackside brick building and nearby house rows correspond in layout and recognizable textures.
observations.vegetation: Near trees and hedges appear in corresponding areas with softer/darker shadows.
observations.transparency: Footbridge/railings retain open gaps; no opaque foliage rectangles seen.
differences: Bevy embankments and track are darker; shadows have softer edges than native.
Far housing/terrain boundary differs at the limited horizon.

observations.buildings: The brick trackside building, cuttings, rails and nearby housetops remain visible in corresponding positions.
observations.vegetation: Trees on the embankment are visible, with different leaf brightness and horizon silhouette.
observations.transparency: Windscreen and visible wire-fence gaps remain clear.
differences: Cab framing is consistent within declared tolerances, while near parallax and the building shade differ.
Signal/instrument state is dynamic and not certified by this scene review.

summary: All 12 Bevy views were inspected with their native references. Nearby station buildings, bridges, house textures, cab geometry and windscreen/fence cutouts remain recognizable, with no gross opaque alpha rectangles or blank replacement buildings apparent in the reviewed pixels. Lighting/sky/shadows differ intentionally. Recorded vegetation and dynamic-occlusion differences prevent a blanket claim of identical scenery.
